title: Austin Development, Library Internet, Community Aid
summary:
*   **Major Urban Development & Infrastructure**: Approved demolition for a Convention Center expansion, construction of the Plaza Saltillo Project (a public space), and advanced design for the Lamar Boulevard Pedestrian and Bicycle Bridge. Public hearings were also set for a significant land annexation.
*   **Key Community & Social Initiatives**: Committed funds to expand public Internet access at all library locations, increased support for social services (including a program for at-risk middle school girls and AIDS care), and scheduled a public hearing regarding the relocation of a transitional treatment facility.
*   **Public Safety, Health & Environmental Concerns**: Discussed citizen concerns about atomic transport accidents and the need for safety equipment. The city also approved a study to evaluate community policing efforts and addressed development regulations in the environmentally sensitive Barton Springs Zone through executive session discussions.
*   **Specific Policy & Aesthetics**: Denied an appeal to allow a 50-foot freestanding sign for Shell Oil Company on I-35, upholding existing sign height limits and visual standards.
